claim_ceiling: Draft case-specific anchors only; no frozen Rubric Version, rater calibration or scored use.

dimensions.anchor_2: Names a relevant missing fact but designs as though it were known.
dimensions.anchor_3: Prioritizes correctness/limit and latency questions and branches design on answers.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Identifies a consequential ambiguity (such as authorization vs settlement) and shows how different answers change the design; `NA` only if clarification was omitted by administration.
dimensions.label: requirement discovery
dimensions.observable_evidence: Opening question: asks about limit semantics, users, failure harms, traffic, latency, retries or external side effects; states assumptions.

dimensions.anchor_2: Says correctness matters but gives no sequencing or degraded behavior.
dimensions.anchor_3: Protects a stated invariant, picks a feasible first mitigation and explains latency/cost impact.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Provides a measurable release/rollback threshold and addresses false rejection/availability as well as breach risk; `NA` only if no product choice was asked.
dimensions.label: product priority
dimensions.observable_evidence: First design and reveal: chooses what to protect/ship first and explains customer and business consequences.

dimensions.anchor_2: Coherent components but one important race/commit boundary is vague.
dimensions.anchor_3: Explains an atomic or serialized mechanism and independent-account parallelism.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Walks through duplicate and failure interleavings without losing the invariant, while naming an unresolved boundary; `NA` only if design path was not requested.
dimensions.label: boundaries/data flow
dimensions.observable_evidence: Sketches request, authoritative allowance, transfer and ledger state, idempotency and failure boundaries.

dimensions.anchor_2: Names a tradeoff but not its mechanism or cost.
dimensions.anchor_3: Explains why chosen coordination meets the invariant and where p99/throughput suffers.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Compares two viable approaches under different workload/semantics and gives a metric/condition for switching; `NA` only if no alternative or quality goal was elicited.
dimensions.label: quality tradeoff
dimensions.observable_evidence: Reveal: compares consistency, hot-key throughput, latency, operational complexity and at least one alternative.

dimensions.anchor_2: Gives monitoring or retry plan with a material safety gap.
dimensions.anchor_3: Distinguishes contention from deadlock and names safe retry plus a rollout check.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Covers ambiguous outcomes/reconciliation and a tested rollback, with residual incident risk; `NA` if the reveal/closing probe was not administered.
dimensions.label: operation/failure
dimensions.observable_evidence: Reveal/closing: diagnoses wait vs deadlock, safe retry, backpressure, metrics, staged rollout/rollback.

dimensions.anchor_2: Adds workers/cache without checking the new constraint.
dimensions.anchor_3: Revises bottleneck mechanism and preserves correctness.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Revises priority/design/measurement coherently, including what earlier assumption failed; `NA` if the fixed reveal was not delivered.
dimensions.label: revision
dimensions.observable_evidence: Explicitly changes or defends design in response to hot-account evidence.
